newsitem.title: UK: Lat Am vehicle output to rise 47 pct by 2000 - EIU.
newsitem.headline: Lat Am vehicle output to rise 47 pct by 2000 - EIU.

text.p: Annual vehicle production in Latin America is expected to rise to over five million by 2000, up 47 percent from 1996, the Economist Intelligence Unit said on Tuesday.

The EIU said in a statement that production was expected to surpass Germany by 2002 because of rising capacity in Latin America and its increasing role as an exporting base for major world manufacturers.
The EIU noted that vehicle makers were expected to invest $14.2 billion in Brazil in the second half of this decade and seven companies were expected to start new factories before 2000.
A further $5.2 billion was expected to be invested in Mexico and $3.9 billion in Argentina.
The EIU said vehicle sales for the region were expected to rise to 3.9 million by 2000, up 42 percent from 1996.
Exports by the region were forecast to rise 57 percent to 2.19 million by 2000, the EIU said.
